name: Ureshino (Japan, city)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ureshino city emblem in green: a ring open at the top with a stylised leaf, in two shades of green.
history: Municipal flag of Ureshino, a city in Saga Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 January 2006.

features.role: Ureshino city emblem — a ring open at the top with a stylised leaf, in two shades of green
